strings.drop.title: Drop a video file here
strings.err.bot_check:
YouTube is asking you to sign in to confirm you’re not a bot.
Go to Settings → Download and enable “Read from browser” (log in to YouTube in that browser first), then retry.
strings.err.cookies_dpapi:
Could not read browser cookies: Chrome/Edge encrypt them with DPAPI, which yt-dlp cannot decrypt.
Use Firefox instead, or export cookies.txt and point to it in settings.
strings.err.empty_subs: Subtitle file is empty or could not be parsed.
strings.err.engine_down:
Cannot reach the translation engine: {err}
Check that Ollama is running, or verify the API settings.
strings.err.impersonate_missing:
TLS impersonation is enabled but yt-dlp lacks curl_cffi.
Run: pip install "yt-dlp[default]"
strings.err.need_ffmpeg: Local video processing needs ffmpeg — install it or set the path in settings.
strings.err.no_api: API base URL or model name is missing
strings.err.no_embedded:
This video has no embedded text subtitles and speech recognition is off.
Enable it under Settings → Speech recognition and install faster-whisper.
strings.err.no_formats:
yt-dlp found no downloadable formats.
This is usually caused by TLS impersonation — YouTube rejects that fingerprint. Turn it off under Settings → Download.
strings.err.no_subs:
This video has no subtitles in the source language.
Enable speech recognition in settings, or try another video.
strings.main.empty:
No tasks yet

Paste a link, or drop a video here
strings.main.merge_tip: Merge caption fragments into full sentences before translating — much better quality
strings.main.url_placeholder: Paste a video link (YouTube / Bilibili / any site yt-dlp supports)
